title: Data Sciences, B.S. (Engineering)
notes: A separate program from the already-built Data Sciences, B.S. (Eberly College of Science) -- different plan code (DTSCE_BS vs the Science college's DS_BS), different college, distinct suggested academic plan. Major code DTSCE avoids colliding with the existing DS code. Built the 'Computational Data Sciences Option' (only option). Bulletin lists 'DS 440W' in Fourth Year Spring, but the real course-descriptions catalog has no such code -- confirmed via the DS department's own course listing page that the real code is 'DS 440: Data Sciences Capstone Course' (no W suffix); used DS 440. Re-scraped ds_catalog.json to pick this up (31 courses). Several real catalog credit values differ from the bulletin table's own annotations (e.g. STAT 184 is 3cr in the catalog, not the bulletin's stated 2) -- trusted the catalog throughout, same as every other bulletin/catalog mismatch handled this session. 'List A Course' and 'List B Course' each appear twice (Fall and Spring of Fourth Year) per the bulletin's own College Notes (Option A / Option B lists) -- picked CMPSC 450 + MATH 484 for the two List A slots and DS 441 + EE 456 for the two List B slots, each chosen because its own prereqs are already fully satisfied elsewhere in this plan (CMPSC 131/MATH 220/MATH 230/MATH 141/CMPSC 360/DS 220). UPDATE after the prereq-parser fix: both DS 200 and STAT 200 (the Semester 1 option pool) require MATH 21, which needs MATH 4, which needs MATH 3 -- none of which were anywhere in this plan; this was also the root cause blocking STAT 184 and (downstream) STAT 380. Added the MATH 3 -> MATH 4 -> MATH 21 chain explicitly (Semesters 1-3); the higher 18cr/semester cap on this plan (vs. 17 on some sibling majors) left enough headroom to absorb the 9 new credits without needing to trim anything else.
